status: not-run as a set. Nothing here is a measured misroute rate.
use: Copy `cases` into a westack-eval routing campaign (kind routing) and register it before any description is tuned. The split is fixed here: score the held-out cases once per description version; scoring them against a changed description turns them into dev cases.
population_needed: Names in `expect` must be in the campaign's population: westack-ship, westack-verify, westack-build, westack-review and westack-debug from this repository. westack-ci is planned, not built: n04 and n06 carry `pending_until_built`, so leave them out of a campaign until that skill exists (their expectation stays as written; never relabel it), then delete the marker. westack-deploy was built at alpha.60 and n05's marker is gone; add westack-deploy to the population. gstack's `ship` is installed on the builder's machine: a population that includes it tests the collision the description is written to avoid, and s12 names it explicitly. Requests with no owner in the population expect NONE.
